DIAGNOSIS READY: Meconium Ileus.

The abdominal X-ray showing dilated bowel loops and an empty rectum, combined with the history of bilious vomiting and failure to pass meconium, is highly specific for a distal intestinal obstruction caused by inspissated meconium, commonly seen in infants with Cystic Fibrosis.
